Recreation of the [[Premiere Limited]] Decipher scan [[File:Premiere-L-c3po.gif]] for [[C-3PO (See-Threepio) (Unlimited)]]. Outer printed-black border painted white with rounded corners; light gray matte (#c8c8c8) around the card so the white round reads on a white page. Interior pixels unchanged.
